alias: Heating: switch to Winter from the forecast
description: Every evening at 18:00, looks at the next two days. If a night is forecast at 4 C or colder, or tomorrow's average is 7 C or lower, it switches to Winter a day ahead so the floor is warm in time. Does nothing otherwise.

if.value_template: {% set f = fc['weather.forecast_home'].forecast %}{% set nxt = f[1:3] %}{{ nxt | length > 0 and (nxt | map(attribute='templow') | map('float', 99) | min <= 4 or ((nxt[0].temperature | float(99)) + (nxt[0].templow | float(99))) / 2 <= 7) }}

data.title: Heating switched to Winter
data.message: Cold weather is forecast: lows {{ fc['weather.forecast_home'].forecast[1:3] | map(attribute='templow') | list }} C. Starting a day ahead so the floor is warm in time.
